notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey while I've been working on finishing Color Fear i had a thought that maybe with all the updates that I've been making on the basic features, intruders and other things, that i should probably update the demo with these features too! Hopefully you guys can enjoy this final demo update. 



This demo closer reflects what the final game will feel like.



I'm very grateful for all the love and support to the project! So on demo completion there is a special flying game mode that has been added for you to enjoy!



Also on demo completion there is also a replay mode that allows you to restart the week without resetting your night points or inventory items.



Wishlist to support Color Fear! Thanks!



Update Features:

-Updated Overall Visuals to make the project feel more immersive

-Flashlight now has a more realistic affect on world and can cast more realistic shadows and will also sway idly.

-Scary Random Noise System has been added

-Updated Intruder Visuals

-Controller UI Selection actually works now

-Jumpscare System has been added!

-At Completion of Demo 2 New Game Modes

-Fly Mode: Enjoy flying as long as you want!

-Replay Mode: replay from the beginning of the week without losing your night points or inventory items.

-Ghost and Intruders can now roam the building

-Updated Item Visuals

-Card Use VFX

-Inventory System Actually Works and you can drop and pickup items seamlessly

-Updated Safe Card Cross VFX

-More Specific Death Messaging

-Fixed a lot of bugs

notes.title: Color Fear Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Color Fear's Release date will be moved to October 21st



I'm taking full accountability for this delay, I really did want it to release in July but it just seems that time isn't on my side for this one. I'm doing my best to shoot scenes, fix bugs and implement everything that is needed for the project as fast as possible. The only thing that is holding me back is the amount of shots that are needed and their details. If i released on July 14th the project would be unfinished and not in my vision, so please give me a bit more time for this greatness.



Color Fear is a project I'm incredibly passionate about so id like to share it with everyone when its ready to be shown! <3



Anyways the project is on track to release on October 21st
